example: 最南边则是一群十三到十六岁的少年
note: Contrasts one group with another; often replaceable with 而 in the learner’s analysis.
english: The southernmost group, by contrast, was a group of teenagers aged thirteen to sixteen.

note: 一声 marks a single vocal burst; 冷哼 is a disdainful snort rather than speaking words.
english: gave a cold snort

note: Heavy dull thud on impact; the character is an audible effect rather than a new setting-specific concept.
english: Thud!

note: A location construction, not a proper noun.
english: below the navel

example: 以成为伟大的战士为荣
note: Be proud of an action or status; preserve the framing of the military ideal.
english: take pride in becoming a great warrior

note: Strong continuing emotion, an idiomatic intensifier; comprehension goes beyond 以/已 as isolated characters.
english: overwhelmed with excitement

note: Fixed reaction idiom: to be startled; not the literal act of eating.
english: was startled

note: A conventional sighing expression, distinct from ordinary speaking.
english: let out a sigh

note: Spoken thinking/acknowledgment particle; reading it aloud preserves the child’s emotional effort.
english: Don’t cry, mm, don’t cry.

note: Boom or crash; links to a physical impact, not a novel-specific term.
english: Boom!

note: Repeated sizzling/burning sound when magical shields meet flame.
english: Sizzle, sizzle

note: Whizz/arrow-flight noise in the fast combat sequence.
english: Whoosh!

note: The dragon tail both wraps and holds the fighter; 住 signals a resulting held state.
english: wrapped tightly around and held

note: Passive and change-of-state result; the archer is reduced to ash.
english: was struck and reduced to ashes

note: Limit the comparison to a single dimension: strength or rank.
english: in terms of strength alone

note: Idiom for animated physical gesturing, preserving a child’s excited storytelling.
english: gesticulating excitedly

note: 竟然 marks an unexpected or surprising event; its literary short form is 竟.
english: was actually standing on top of its head

note: An involuntary physical reaction rather than a deliberate action.
english: involuntarily swayed for a moment

note: A light ringing/tinkling sound as the magical ring activates.
english: Ting—

note: Onomatopoeia describes the heartbeat; 地 marks adverbial manner.
english: beat with a thump, thump

example: 林雷在心里高兴地问道
note: The immediately preceding speaker is Lin Lei; source 林德 is a name corruption.
english: Lin Lei asked happily in his mind

note: The protective armor changes material with the caster’s rank; keep ranks distinct.
english: fifth- and sixth-rank mages

note: Hypothetical consequence; mental power is needed to control magical energy.
english: if mental power were not controlling it

example: 每天清晨和傍晚仍然要参加战士训练
note: Contrast routine physical training with morning studies and later meditation.
english: still had to attend warrior training every morning and evening

example: 只要迅猛龙用长鞭般的尾巴横扫一下
note: Hypothetical consequence of a single tail sweep; the next sentence expresses likelihood with 恐怕.
english: as long as the swift dragon sweeps its whip-like tail once

note: A natural realization/question filler; source 恩 is preserved only in the original.
english: Hmm?

note: Distinguish rising intensity of a magical resonance from ordinary loudness.
english: the vibrating sound became more and more intense

example: 林雷在心里高兴地问道
note: The question is transmitted internally and must not be treated as audible speech.
english: Lin Lei asked happily in his mind

note: Counterfactual question followed by a concessive conditional; even high power cannot substitute for spell knowledge.
english: What if no one teaches you? Even if…

example: 至于圣域，那就更遥远了
note: Shifts from ordinary warrior ranks to the much more distant Saint realm.
english: As for the Saint realm, that is even further away.

example: 热血沸腾、充满激情的生活
note: An expressive, source-faithful description of the boys’ imagined heroic future.
english: a passionate life that makes the blood boil

pattern: 专名异名：大地之戒／盘龙之戒
note: Delin named the artifact 大地之戒; Lin Lei uses 盘龙之戒. Different names for the same ring, not a source inconsistency.
english: named it the Ring of Earth

note: Signals that dialogue with DeLin is telepathic, not spoken out loud.
english: Lin Lei tried speaking in his mind

example: 可这只黑色老鼠却很可爱
note: Contrasts ordinary disliked mice with this unusual, appealing shadowmouse.
english: yet this black mouse was very cute

example: 就连六七岁的孩子，也差不多都起床参加早晨的传统训练了
note: Even an unexpected member of a group does the action; stronger contrast than simple 也.
english: even the six- and seven-year-old children had more or less all got up for the traditional morning training

example: 即使我拥有十二个城镇的领地，庄园里也找不到像你这么厉害的护卫队长
note: Concessive even-if claim with limited negation.
english: Even if I owned the territory of twelve towns, I could not find a guard captain as capable as you on my estate.

note: Colloquial directive not to intervene in others’ affairs.
english: Just don’t intervene.

example: 一边翻滚嘶吼，一边朝四面八方飞去
note: Two simultaneous actions in a fast combat description.
english: rolling and screaming while flying off in every direction

note: Each item has its own properties; contrasts systems without asserting the same type.
english: magic and battle qi each have their own attributes

note: Figurative comparison used for the young shadowmouse’s eyes.
english: as if they could speak
